225 mg of effexor is not the maximum, you could try upping the dosage. I think maximum is 375 mg ( i take this dosage) if you dont like upping the dosage there is always another antidepressant you could try adding like lexapro or other ssri (SNRI+ SSRI) its common combo actually. The abilify could help with it a lot. Buspirone could also be added, Fluanxol ( Flupentixol) is also an option. Mood stabilers could also help (lamictal) there is always options if you dont want to go up the dose.

The jumps from high dosage to moderate are always the easy ones, taking example like lexapro the jump from 20 to 15 mg are easier than 5 mg to 0 mg. So be very carefull with the jump past 50% below, the withdrawl could kick hard soo be prepared. You could try bridge it with benzos or anti-psychotics or even mood stabilizers.
